files.treatment: A: upstream anchored menu, submenus, keyboard and pointer grace; local imports; autofocus waits for placement #393: all menu geometry is Floating UI's (@floating-ui/react-dom 2.1.9: offset, flip, shift, size, autoUpdate, fixed strategy). The hand-written portal geometry (anchor/list measurement, viewport clamping, capture-phase scroll and resize listeners), the CSS-positioned in-place list with its portal prop, and the CSS-positioned submenu card are removed. The list is always a body-portaled Floating UI surface (side/align map to one placement; getAnchorRect is a virtual reference), and each open submenu is a body-portaled Floating UI surface anchored to its own row (right-end, flipping to left-end, shifted and size-bounded, with a side-aware pointer bridge). size() publishes the room the viewport leaves as CSS custom properties that Menu.module.css combines with the design bounds. A submenu is its own keyboard layer: ArrowRight, Enter, Space or Tab on its row enter it, the arrows, Home and End walk only the focused layer, and Escape or ArrowLeft inside it return to its row. The upstream API (less portal), DOM classes, selection, disabled rows, pointer grace and focus restoration are retained; floating surfaces are React Aria top layers, Escape stops at the menu before a containing React Aria modal, and selected rows announce aria-current. #393 repair: every surface lives only while its reference is a visible interaction anchor (Floating UI hide, referenceHidden): a list whose anchor leaves layout, is detached or is clipped out closes through onClose; a submenu whose row scrolls out of its card closes. A keyboard either held goes to the trigger, the anchor's first enabled button or the nearest rendered focus container (a containing dialog), never to a hidden control or an unmounting row. #393 correction: a liveness close is not a dismissal. A list whose anchor is hidden settles a keyboard it held on the nearest containing focus owner without scrolling, never on the hidden trigger; a submenu whose row is hidden leaves the keyboard on the still-open list, never on the clipped row; Escape and ArrowLeft still return it to a visible row. #393 repair: a hidden anchor's keyboard goes to the focusOwner its host names, with no [tabindex] ancestor inference; with none named it is released, never left on a removed row or a hidden anchor. #393 repair: a submenu the keyboard holds (being entered, or focus inside its card) is never replaced or closed by passive hover; a pointer press on a parent row moves the keyboard to that row before it takes over. A placement reporting referenceHidden stops presenting its surface in the same render, and the layout phase of that commit settles the keyboard and closes the surface once, before paint. #400 focus lifecycle: portal into a containing Settings dialog scope when present; Floating UI geometry, reference-hidden settlement, keyboard behavior and owners unchanged.
